author: ProfessorUtonium
body:
What the title says
put down what you think

Keep the Speed. Get rid of fire resistance it is useless. Change it with like a different but usable potion like NIGHT VISION. With night vision u will be able to see underground better. (Same points as speed and level)

Get rid of jukebox/discs. Replace with Blocks like 16 wood logs and 32 glass (on most maps I keep running out of blocks.
(Wood = 3 points glass = 2 level 1)
Make the spanky spade knockback 2 (30 points level 30) add a spanky spade Jr which is iron knockback 1 (10 points level 10) 

Keep the gold apples and change the flame torch to like magma cream(therefore u can't accidentally place it and loose the enchants)

Put down what you think!
